ScribeSourceGate.item: Check that S432 was opened this round and that its correction can cite S432 without adding a SOURCES row; draft a Gate pointer using exact source location. Do not edit files.

ScribeQualityScope.item: Review proposed criterion scope for web-property publishing evidence; ensure it is domain-specific and not generic source-method duplication owned by chousa. Do not edit files.

ScribeTrendVerdicts.item: Derive possible expansion, quality and discernment trends from the frozen task and baseline only; distinguish evidence still owed from verdicts. Do not assert after-state.

ScoutSourceRegistry.item: Check S432 SOURCES row, used-by and status; determine exact permissible registry edits under contract-v1, and whether this round should change any cells.

ScoutQUALITY.item: Read current corpus/QUALITY.md and round-61 verifier finding; identify whether an equivalent substantive-quote criterion already exists and how to add without rewriting history.

ScoutLearningPath.item: Check calibration claim and proposed 1-to-0 unresolved disagreement counter against LEARNING.md discernment definition; report if mismatch means claim is not calibration.

ScoutAxisFloor.item: Check SCORECARD owned axis scores and retired/planned status; independently verify calibration is lowest non-retired and claim targets it.

ScoutCountPopulation.item: Independently derive the baseline S432 Disagree population from committed spot-check bytes and report command/output plus scope of the count.

ScoutNoHarm.item: Inspect claim's affected files and outline read-only checks to detect unintended source-status, coverage-map, score changes.

ScoutSourceQuoteClass.item: Check exact quote in retained S432 body for page uniqueness and meaningful context, using source body only; report section, line and literal.

ScoutLessonLatest.item: Check newest round-61 lesson/spotcheck defects routed to kake and enumerate the ones still actionable for this round.

ScoutCounterDataflow.item: Read c62 counter and assess whether its read set derives from committed blobs at supplied revision, rather than working tree or outputs.

ScoutPriorMistakes.item: Inspect round-61 lesson mistakes and verifier defect; propose one mistake classification and a testable fix criterion, with evidence.

ScoutUnresolvedMetric.item: Challenge definition of unresolved S432 disagreement: must preserve raw verifier row and make resolution evidence-dependent, not erase finding. Inspect counter implementation.

ScoutEventScope.item: Read round-61 trend/verifier findings and evaluate whether quality and discernment were harmed; suggest transparent round-62 trend reporting only.

ExecutorCounterMutation5.item: In private scratch, test whether unrelated text can contain the exact quote and trigger correction without an appended round-62 correction; report outcome.

ExecutorCounterMutation11.item: Check quote and correction markers against retained body sha and section line numbers; report exact command and output.

ExecutorCounterMutation12.item: Assess counter's strictness on response-header entry citation form and count true positive vs false positive on base; scratch only.

ExecutorCounterDataIntegrity.item: Verify base revision and source/spot-check blobs are read from Git objects, not changed worktree; give hashes/commands.

ReviewerQualityCriterion.item: Review proposed source-quote criterion for scope, testability, evidence grounding and duplicate criterion; point to exact QUALITY rows.

ReviewerCensus.item: Falsify census-before claim and verify no S432 registry status/recheck/used-by change is needed; use contract-v1 counting command.

ReviewerAxis.item: Adversarially check this claim meets lowest non-retired calibration axis and isn't merely quality-only or sourced content work.

ReviewerEvidence.item: Audit evidence citations and commands for every asserted after-state; classify unrun independent review honestly.

ReviewerBoundary.item: Check this correction stays in kake web-properties province and doesn't absorb Fetch-standard research method or browser behavior.

ReviewerCounterControls.item: Attack c62 counter's base and after claims: test trivial marker/always-clean/data-copy controls in your isolated scratch; report false-green potential.

ReviewerQuoteTruth.item: Check literal substantive S432 quote against exact retained source text and one-page occurrence; report if truncation/malformed quote remains.

ReviewerTrendGuard.item: Challenge likely expansion/quality/discernment trend verdicts under LEARNING.md; require concrete source/corpus evidence and don't overclaim.

ReviewerCounterDataflow.item: Review counter's revision-bound Git blob reads, source-row existence check and lesson/quality proof; find a route to false positive.

ReviewerReportCompleteness.item: Review required report structure and round evidence contract, especially one frozen claim, S433/S432 source reopening, census, lesson, mistakes and SHONEN.

CriticCalibrationMeaning.item: Argue whether correcting an admission mismatch plus a criterion is a measurable calibration axis move rather than source quality; identify what evidence separates them.

CriticQuoteDefect.item: Critique round-61 quote defect and proposed correction: does substantive text actually ground the entry's claim, and does the correction address exact disagreement?

CriticCounterWeakness.item: Seek counter false-greens from token presence, path omission, revision substitution or old text; test scratch variants only.

CriticClaimScope.item: Check frozen claim doesn't silently expand to resolving all corpus disagreements; list explicit limits and falsification cases.

MutationBaseReachability.item: Test base, do-nothing, quote-only and criterion-only variants in private scratch against the frozen counter; report outputs and residuals.

ConnectorMistakes.item: Connect this round's source-quote disagreement to prior kake corpus mistakes and identify whether same failure class recurred; evidence pointers required.
